description: This file implements an OAuth2 authentication handler for Mattermost plugins, defining the OAuther interface, its implementation, and related functions for managing OAuth2 tokens, URLs, and payloads.

classes.name: OAuther
classes.description: Interface defining OAuth2 flow operations such as token retrieval, URL generation, deauthorization, and payload addition.

classes.name: oAuther
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the OAuther interface, managing OAuth2 state, tokens, and HTTP handling.

methods.name: GetConnectURL
methods.description: Returns the URL to initiate the OAuth2 connection process.

methods.name: GetToken
methods.description: Retrieves the OAuth2 token for a specific user ID from the store.

methods.name: Deauthorize
methods.description: Removes the stored token for a user ID, effectively deauthorizing the user.

methods.name: ServeHTTP
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests for OAuth2 connect and complete endpoints.

methods.name: AddPayload
methods.description: Stores additional payload data associated with a user ID.
